newsitem.title: COSTA RICA: China, the coffee world's hope for consumption.
newsitem.headline: China, the coffee world's hope for consumption.

text.p: China is the big future hope for coffee producing nations to boost consumption, the president of France's green coffee organisation, UNACAF, said here Monday.

"The big question for consumption is China. Right now the Chinese consume insignificant amounts of coffee, around 20 grammes per person per year," Roger Chaudemanche told delegates here at the International Coffee Week, known in Spanish as Sintercafe.
Chaudemanche predicted that, if Chinese coffee tastes could be promoted, by 2010 China could consume around 3 million 60-kg bags per year.

Japan, the Philippines and Taiwan also had much growth potential in terms of consumption, he said, adding that it was expected that India would consume all its output by the year 2000. He gave no specific figures for India.

Chaudemanche, on the preimse that consumnption has risen around 1 million bags per year in recent years, said that he predicted that global consumption would be around 110 million bags by 2010 from the 95 million consumed in 1995, 72 million by producer nations and 23 million by producer nations.
